title: 腾讯入局Personal Agent赛道:代号"Handy Bot"，已在微信低调内测
content:
According to "Dujia", Tencent is secretly developing a Personal Agent (Personal AI Agent) product, internally codenamed "Handy Bot", and plans to launch an independent app. The product has already been quietly launched on WeChat, with the service account description reading "Your Personal AI Agent".
Handy Bot's positioning is entirely different from traditional chatbots. Traditional chatbots work on a question-and-answer basis, and tasks end once the conversation ends. In contrast, a Personal Agent aims for a "background presence" — users only need to provide a general goal, and the AI can continuously advance the task in the cloud, no longer relying on humans issuing instructions one by one.
Meta's recent release of Muse is a landmark product in this direction. Its core design is to assign each user a dedicated secure virtual machine to handle daily tasks such as price comparisons, email processing, and schedule monitoring.
Tencent is not the only player in this space. Alibaba is evolving Qwen towards "My Qwen", emphasizing the construction of personal context memory; Douyin's Duanbao has also been reported to be developing a personal assistant product codenamed "Spell". The industry consensus is that for Personal Agent to truly take off, it needs to balance the model's task planning capabilities, the openness of the ecosystem tools, and the compliance and privacy boundaries. Currently, Handy Bot is still in internal testing, and the product details have not been finalized yet.

report.summary: 腾讯内测个人AI代理Handy Bot，微信服务号已低调上线。
report.background: 从ChatGPT式问答机器人到能自主执行任务的Agent，行业正经历范式迁移。近期Meta发布Muse，为每个用户分配独立安全虚拟机处理比价、邮件、日程等日常任务，被视为该方向的标志性产品。国内大厂迅速跟进：阿里让通义千问向"My Qwen"演进，强调个人上下文记忆；抖音豆包被曝研发代号"Spell"的个人助手。腾讯此时以代号"Handy Bot"切入，并借微信服务号低调试水，意在抢占个人Agent这一新入口。
key_points: Handy Bot定位与聊天机器人完全不同：用户只需给出大目标，AI在云端持续后台推进任务，不必一步步下指令。
Meta新发布的Muse是这一方向的标杆，它为每个用户分配专属安全虚拟机，自动完成比价、邮件处理、日程监控等日常事务。
腾讯并不孤单：阿里通义千问正转向"My Qwen"强化个人记忆，抖音豆包也在研发代号"Spell"的个人助理产品。
行业共识是个人Agent要真正跑通，必须同时解决模型任务规划能力、生态工具开放度，以及合规与隐私边界三大难题。
目前Handy Bot仍处内测阶段，产品细节尚未定稿，微信服务号介绍仅写着"你的个人AI代理"。
report.impact: 对AI行业，个人Agent正成为继大模型、聊天助手之后的新一代入口之争，微信生态的加入可能重塑流量与分发格局。对开发者，竞争焦点从提示词工程转向任务编排、云端沙箱与工具生态集成，垂直场景和工具接口是机会点。对普通用户，交互从"问答"升级为"托管"，便利性大幅提升，但数据授权、隐私边界与误操作风险也随之上升，需谨慎设置权限。
report.tools: 想跟进可关注：OpenAI Operator与ChatGPT Tasks、Anthropic Computer Use、开源项目OpenHands、Browser Use、LangGraph、n8n等Agent编排与浏览器操作框架，以及微信服务号"Handy Bot"的内测入口。
